import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int n, t;
    static int[] left, right, col;
    static char[][] grid, grid1;
    static int[][] d, d1;
    static Queue<Node> q;
    static Cap[][] caps;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v;

    static class Node {
        int i, j, no;
        Node(int i, int j, int no) {
            this.i = i;
            this.j = j;
            this.no = no;
        }
    }

    static class Cap {
        int[] no;
        int ind;
        int fl;
        Cap() {
            no = new int[1001];
            ind = 0;
            fl = 0;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(Node s) {
        int i, j, k, l;
        i = s.i;
        j = s.j;
        d[i][j] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            i = temp.i;
            j = temp.j;
            k = i + 1;
            l = j;
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (k < n) {
                if (d[k][l] > d[i][j] + 1) {
                    d[k][l] = d[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i - 1;
            l = j;
            if (k >= 0) {
                if (d[k][l] > d[i][j] + 1) {
                    d[k][l] = d[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i;
            l = j + 1;
            if (l < n) {
                if (d[k][l] > d[i][j] + 1) {
                    d[k][l] = d[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i;
            l = j - 1;
            if (l >= 0) {
                if (d[k][l] > d[i][j] + 1) {
                    d[k][l] = d[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfst(Node s) {
        int i, j, k, l;
        d1 = new int[1000][1000];
        for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        i = s.i;
        j = s.j;
        d1[i][j] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            i = temp.i;
            j = temp.j;
            if (d1[i][j] > t) continue;
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            if (caps[i][j].fl == 1) {
                if (d1[i][j] <= t && d1[i][j] <= d[i][j]) {
                    for (k = 1; k <= caps[i][j].ind; k++) {
                        v[s.no].add(caps[i][j].no[k]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d1[i][j] >= d[i][j]) continue;
            k = i + 1;
            l = j;
            if (k < n) {
                if (d1[k][l] > d1[i][j] + 1) {
                    d1[k][l] = d1[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i - 1;
            l = j;
            if (k >= 0) {
                if (d1[k][l] > d1[i][j] + 1) {
                    d1[k][l] = d1[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i;
            l = j + 1;
            if (l < n) {
                if (d1[k][l] > d1[i][j] + 1) {
                    d1[k][l] = d1[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
            k = i;
            l = j - 1;
            if (l >= 0) {
                if (d1[k][l] > d1[i][j] + 1) {
                    d1[k][l] = d1[i][j] + 1;
                    Node temp1 = new Node(k, l, 0);
                    q.add(temp1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean dfs(int s) {
        if (col[s] != 0) return false;
        int i, k;
        col[s] = 1;
        for (i = 0; i < v[s].size(); i++) {
            k = v[s].get(i);
            if (left[k] == -1) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (dfs(left[k])) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int match(int n) {
        left = new int[1000];
        right = new int[1000];
        col = new int[1000];
        Arrays.fill(left, -1);
        Arrays.fill(right, -1);
        int i, done;
        do {
            done = 1;
            Arrays.fill(col, 0);
            for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (right[i] == -1 && dfs(i)) done = 0;
            }
        } while (done == 0);
        int k = 0;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (right[i] != -1) k++;
        }
        return k;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        grid = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        grid1 = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid1[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        d = new int[1000][1000];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        caps = new Cap[100][100];
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 100; j++) {
                caps[i][j] = new Cap();
            }
        }

        v = new ArrayList[1000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        q = new LinkedList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Node temp = new Node(i, j, 0);
                    bfs(temp);
                }
            }
        }

        int mark = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid1[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) caps[i][j].fl = 1;
                    caps[i][j].ind = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        caps[i][j].no[l] = mark++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mark = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Node temp = new Node(i, j, mark++);
                        bfst(temp);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(match(mark - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
